exposure: frequency of NICU visits by mother
outcome: Infant Appearance and Behavior (PSS: NICU subscale)
Sights and Sounds of NICU (PSS: NICU subscale)
cohort: The study included 122 mothers of preterm infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU).
finding: Mothers of preterm infants admitted to the NICU experience significant stress, with parental role alteration being the greatest stressor, and stress levels correlating positively with maternal age and NICU treatment duration, and negatively with frequency of NICU visits, while positively associating with neonatal seizures and invasive ventilation.
cross-section timing: During the infant's admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
